text:
**My pick: the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**, if you want one dependable bedside or desk stand. Which one is best for you depends on your iPhone model and budget.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, the phone pad tilts, and landscape/StandBy mode works. It lists at $109, with WIRED showing about $98 direct, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Warranty is 2 years. [Shop links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It does Qi2 25W for iPhone, and the pad angles for portrait or landscape. A power adapter isn't included, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25). [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

- **Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station.** It charges the iPhone at 15W and includes a charger and cable. WIRED listed it at $40 on Amazon, down from $80. The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

- **25W with active cooling: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1.** It comes with a 50W adapter, and the fan has an off button for sleeping (per [WIRED's travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)). It's $99.99 at ESR. A coupon site, Dealectric, lists code PARTNER18 for about $82 and says it tested the code, but the checkout price is what counts. [Buy via Dealectric's ESR link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). It's an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. Per that page, 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other recent models get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.

- **Best if you want it taller or foldable: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99.** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It holds the phone over 70mm off the desk, includes a 45W adapter, and folds for travel. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

- **Best if you want your devices out of sight: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130).** Everything lies flat, with Qi2 25W for the phone. The Apple Watch charges slowly, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## How to choose
- Overnight charging: 25W makes little difference. WIRED says the faster ESR is "far more expensive for very little gain" over the 15W model, so the Belkin or the $40 ESR is plenty.
- 25W only helps with newer iPhones (16 and 17 series, with some exceptions), so check your model first.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging for the third spot to work.

Prices come from the articles and change often, so confirm at checkout.
